_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score is coiling with canceling up/down tails and no imminent macro catalyst; HOLD is the base-rate-honest call until funding/ETF/liquidity or Fear&Greed breaks the range.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward is HOLD/Anxiety coil; narrative implies accumulation-bottom constructive bias without an explicit phase/direction match
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, Fear & Greed ~28-42, funding near flat, no ETF-flow or liquidity impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: Vol break with F&G under 25 and funding negative (down to Denial) OR sustained push with ETF flows returning and F&G above 45 (up to Complacency)
